answer: An identity stays established by presenting a renewal receipt chained to its last settled verdict: the verdict txid, a countersignature from one juror in that jury set, and a 5,000 POA burn that epoch. The node checks all three at renewal; a broken link leaves it seatless next epoch. Like a vine, standing grows from its own prior growth: clone N cannot borrow clone 1's receipt, since the signature binds to a verdict only clone N earned and exists after settlement. A farm cannot pre-buy standing across its timber of fake names; each fake pays and earns its verdict, every horizon it survives.
